note: Candidates retired against the calibration table (INHERITED-EVIDENCE section 2). Rows 1-4 are p >= 0.80 and are not worth building; only rows 5-6 are. A candidate is a proposal, not a measurement, so retiring one loses no evidence - but the row and the reason are recorded per id so the decision is auditable and reversible.
retainedDespiteRow1to4: A candidate still referenced by a probe, promotion or lineage record is KEPT whatever its row. A dangling reference makes coverage reports lie, which is exactly what the check gate exists to catch, and the first attempt at this retirement broke it.
caveat: The classifier reads only what a candidate declared about itself and DEFAULTS to the easiest row when no marker for a harder row is present. The defensible claim is 'these candidates' own declared text contains no marker of rows 5-6', not 'these are provably easy'. Any of them can be reinstated by rewriting its declaration to name a row-5 or row-6 mechanism.
